Title: Warmwink Steam Eye Masks
Body (HTML):
Open the sachet and the mask warms itself to around 40°C for about twenty minutes. No plug, no microwave, no screen. Hook it over your ears, lie back, and let your eyes be off duty for a while.

  • Self-heating: air starts it
  • Individually sealed, single-use
  • Soft fabric, stretch ear loops, one size
  • Unscented or lightly scented

Inside the heat pad: iron powder, water, activated carbon, vermiculite, salt. Scented masks contain fragrance.

Please note: for adults only. Remove contact lenses first. Take the mask off if it feels too hot. Not a medical device. Read the full safety information before use.
